messages:
Elaine (docs): I opened a tiny PR to add a concrete export example + UX suggestion for the audit-log download flow. Pls review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489
Sam (eng): On it. Quick question: are we targeting JSONL as the primary example or CSV?
Elaine (docs): Primary is JSONL, but I included a CSV header mapping table. Goal: minimal example rows that are clearly non-sensitive and match our audit schema.
Priya (legal): Thanks. High-level: do NOT include raw IPs, emails, or unhashed user ids. Use placeholders like "<redacted>" or a hashed token. Also avoid the term "anonymized" unless irreversible.
Marco (platform): Agreed. Also propose we use "actor_id" -> "hashed_actor_id" in samples to reflect pseudonymization. And surface "actor_type" (user/service) so implementers know the shape.
Sam (eng): We emit "actor_type" already — +1. Also suggest including an optional "kms_key_id" in the example (marked optional) so teams recognize it's present in some exports.
Elaine (docs): Current snippet in the PR: ```json
{"timestamp":"2024-04-04T12:00:00Z","hashed_actor_id":"sha256:8f14e45fceea167a5a36dedd4bea2543","actor_type":"user","event_type":"api_key.create","ip":"<redacted>","kms_key_id":"optional:kms-1234","details":{"sdk":"python","action":"CreateKey"}}
```
Priya (legal): That shape looks fine. Two doc copy tweaks: 1) use "pseudonymized or redacted" instead of "PII removed"; 2) add a short note under the sample: "Fields containing sensitive identifiers are redacted or pseudonymized in examples."
Marco (platform): For the UX thought: should exports include a metadata header like "export_time" and "requested_by"? That aids customer auditability. If included, show how it appears as a top-level JSON object and as a CSV metadata row.
Elaine (docs): Good idea. I'll add an "__metadata" top-level object in the JSONL example and a CSV header row example.
Priya (legal): If we show requested_by in examples, note in the copy that public docs use pseudonymized values; actual customer exports may contain real IDs depending on tenant settings.
Sam (eng): I'll run the mapping table locally to validate render and ensure field names match runtime output. If schema drift, I'll flag changes in the PR.
lint-bot: docs lint check — sample-json-literal should be fenced with ```json.
Elaine (docs): Fixed fencing and rebased. Requested reviews from @Sam @Priya @Marco. Will merge after legal ACK + CI green. :thumbsup:
